title: Skill Passport
subtitle: Prove what you can do. Your teacher checks your work and you get a credential anyone can verify.
walletEmptyBody: Pick a skill below, do the task and send your photos. When your teacher approves, your credential appears here.

task.rubricHint: Your work should show all of these.
task.maxPhotos: You can add up to 3 photos.
task.notePlaceholder: Tell what you did, what tools you used…
task.micError: Could not use the microphone. You can type instead.
task.sent: Sent! Your teacher will check it soon.
task.needPhotoOrNote: Add a photo or a note first.
task.waitingBody: You sent your work. You will get a notification when it is checked.
task.approvedBody: Your credential is ready in your passport.
task.needsWorkTitle: Your teacher asks you to improve
task.failed: Could not send. Please try again.

verify.title: Credential check
verify.validBody: This credential was issued by ExcelAIt and has not been changed.
verify.revokedBody: ExcelAIt has withdrawn this credential. Do not rely on it.
verify.invalidBody: We could not confirm this credential. It may be fake, changed, or the link is wrong.
verify.how1: A teacher looked at the student's real work and a checklist.
verify.how2: ExcelAIt signed the details with a secret key (Ed25519).
verify.how3: This page re-checks the signature with our public key. If anything was changed, it fails.

attach.title: Attach your credentials
attach.hint: Show what you can do. Partners will see these verified skills.
attach.none: You have no credentials yet. Prove a skill in your Skill Passport.
